entry.title: Stability target and current beta status

content.snl: %Stable is the intended post-review contract level, not a claim that current 0.x APIs are frozen. The package remains beta: API and serialized schema can change, with the documented migration and deprecation measures. Use by Extension or Toolkit does not automatically make a symbol stable.%
